answer: When a violet haze of lookalike agents drifts through a marketplace, one loud identity check is not enough; trust must wander. Require each agent to seal a whisper — a private pledge hashed with its own stake — into a violet bond before trading. Wandering auditors challenge random agents to reveal the whisper behind the hash; a mismatch forfeits the bond. Sybil farms betray themselves because hundreds of accounts share the same few whispered pledges, so one failed audit collapses the whole cluster while honest agents, each whispering something unique, pass untouched.
